Type: stool
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Whit Contemporary Leather Counter Height Stool with Gold Accents, 37"H, Light Brown
Colors: Light Brown Leather
The dual-height stretcher bars that lend this high-rise barstool additional support double as a comfort-enhancing footrest. The rounded, open-backed design, upholstered in gorgeous light brown leather, lends an air of contemporary chic and modern sensibility to any setting. 20"D x 20"W x 37"H; Seat Height: 26" Solid wood frame & legs with dark brown finish with gold accents Dual-height stretcher bars add stability and double as a convenient footrest Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty
